commits.summary: headless wgpu 27.0.1 GpuBackend (RenderBackend port), device generation/loss, byte-accounted residency, WGSL solid/tile Normal/Multiply/Screen composite, chunked read-back, report

capabilities_done: GpuContext::acquire/acquire_next: headless instance+adapter+device, no surface, validation layers off, bounded block_on, generation counter, device-lost callback + uncaptured-error latch

GpuBackend (Ready|Lost|Unavailable state, Mutex), new() never fails, reacquire(cancel) explicit recovery (generation+1, residency cleared), with_injected_loss (doc(hidden) fault injection), simulate_device_loss (real device.destroy path)
Residency: pure-Rust LRU with pins, hard budget, exact used/peak/evictions counters, mark/release_since (release on every exit)
WGSL kernel.wgsl: one compute pass per layer, straight-alpha source-over + Normal/Multiply/Screen, same formula as pigment blend_math::composite_over

plan_sink: admit() first, source verification (hash/stride/shape/domain), then chunk loop (chunk shrinks to fit min(request.max_working_bytes, residency budget, device buffer limit)), clear + per-layer dispatch + staging read-back into TileSink; receipt only after last chunk
exactness table: tile/solid exact, blend normal/multiply/screen fitted, fill_opacity approximate, everything else unsupported (refused at admission)
report(): one Observe terminal frame, same outcome mapping as render-cpu

observe outcome mapping reuses render-cpu's (BudgetExceeded -> Validation) rather than the brief's (BudgetExceeded -> Unsupported) so one BackendError has one terminal outcome on every backend.
